# The root of wisdom in Part I / 智慧之根在第一部分

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`wisdom-root-part-one` · **reviewed-scoped** · argument · F11 · [record](wisdom-root-part-one.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> The checked laws of registration, 理, testing, learning and generalization, selection and training, enough, runaway, judgment and the meta level, and the routes of formation hold axiom-free of every learner and representation keeping the same content: the formal support of the wisdom-root target.
>
> 识、理、检验、学习与推广、经识的选择与训练、够、失控、判断与元层次的已检查规律及形成路线，不用公理地对每个学习者与保留相同内容的每个表示成立：这是目标 wisdom-root 的形式支撑。

## Exact statement / 确切陈述

Each law below is stated for every formation, learner, lumping, selection or determined law, with no axiom and its conditions written into its theorem, so no representation keeping the same content escapes it. Together with the formal routes of formation, these laws are the formal support for wisdom-root (the universal laws and routes of formation within Part I's scope).

下列每条规律都对每个形成、每个学习者、每个归并、每个选择或每个确定的律陈述，不用公理，其条件写在定理中，所以保留相同内容的任何表示都避不开它。连同形成的形式路线，它们是目标 wisdom-root 的形式支撑（第一部分所及的普遍规律与形成路线）。

## Laws / 规律

1. Registration: a claim is refuted only through a registered difference, and no record fixes the next value.<br>识：主张只经所识的差别被否证，无记录固定下一个。 (`Becoming.Web.Refutes.not_of_alike`, `Becoming.Web.tail_unrefuted`, `Becoming.Learning.no_record_fixes_next`)
2. 理 (Ren's reading: the modeling of the laws of structure and change): data alone fix no untried value; generalization reaches exactly what a lumping lumps and is right exactly where the world goes alike across it; structure and change are one lumping; a projection carries a law exactly where configurations alike go alike.<br>理（Ren 的读法：对结构与变化之规律的建模）：数据单独不固定任何未试之值，推广恰在归并之处、正确恰在世界经归并同去之处，结构与变化是同一个归并，投影恰在相同者同去时承载规律。 (`Becoming.Learning.every_determines_nothing`, `Becoming.Learning.determines_lumped_iff`, `Becoming.Learning.lumped_right_iff`, `Becoming.Learning.goAlike_iff_lumped`, `Becoming.carries_law_iff`)
3. Testing: refutation relative to a model refutes the model and the claim together; the record fixes an act's outcome only where taken; replication is return; one occasion stands for its class under the model.<br>检验：相对于模型的否证是对模型与主张一起的否证，记录只在取过之处固定动作的结果，重复是返回，一次场合代表经模型相同的类。 (`Becoming.Web.refutesWithin_iff_conjunction`, `Becoming.Run.not_fixes_of_untaken`, `Becoming.Run.fixes_on_return`, `Becoming.Run.generalizes`)
4. Learning: in a world held by a list, learning by refutation is refuted a bounded number of times, its coming to rest is unrefuted and its record never shows that it has come to rest; every learner has an open course refuting each of its claims.<br>学习：被列表所持的世界中按否证学习的否证有界、静止不能被否证、其记录从不表明它已静止；每个学习者都有否证它每个主张的开放的序列。 (`Becoming.Learning.held_learner_bounded`, `Becoming.Learning.held_rest_unrefuted`, `Becoming.Learning.no_record_fixes_next_finite`, `Becoming.Learning.diagonal_refutes`, `Becoming.Learning.diagonal_open`)
5. 明 (others' registration): what the clearer cannot test the dweller can, and together they test what neither can alone; selection through registration is blind beyond the registration closure, and pooled registration selects what it misses.<br>明（他者之识）：清除者不能检验的栖居者能，合起来能检验各自都不能的；经识的选择在识闭包之外不见，合起来的识选出它。 (`Becoming.Clearing.tested_by_dweller`, `Becoming.Clearing.pooled`, `Becoming.Flow.unselected_beyond_registration`, `Becoming.Clearing.selected_pooled`)
6. Enough: seeking rests exactly at a state the law leaves unchanged that meets its target; “more than now” needs an open world; two seekers of “above all others” never rest together.<br>够：寻求恰在到达律所不变、满足其目标的状态时静止；“比现在更多”需要开放的世界；“高于一切他者”的两个寻求者从不同时静止。 (`Becoming.Law.rests_iff`, `Becoming.more_needs_open`, `Becoming.Law.aboveAll_never_rests`)
7. Runaway: before the break, how far it is does not register, while observing the stock registers it.<br>失控：断裂之前断裂还有多远不被识，观察储量则识之。 (`Becoming.Web.break_not_bounded`, `Becoming.Web.observed_raise_registers`)
8. Proxies: selection and training go only through the selector's registration or the data; values beyond the data stay as free as the class leaves them; reaching beyond the registration closure to raise what registers is selected.<br>代理：选择与训练只经选择者之识或数据，数据之外的值与类同样自由，伸出识闭包之外而抬高所识者被选中。 (`Becoming.Web.selects_alike_iff`, `Becoming.Learning.Training.loss_through`, `Becoming.Learning.Training.unselected_beyond_data`, `Becoming.Diversion.favours`)
9. Judgment: a judgment from registration is exactly a common response of the judging process over the belief.<br>判断：由识作出的判断恰是判断过程在信念上的共同回应。 (`Becoming.commonResponse_judge_iff`, `Becoming.Web.belief_judge_iff`)
10. The meta level: learning over classes is the same learning over a merged enumeration; every merging has its diagonal course; a system changing its own rule has its law on the joint configuration.<br>元层次：对类的学习是合并枚举上的同一学习，每种合并都有其对角序列，改变自身规则的系统的规律在联合配置上。 (`Becoming.Learning.merged_bound`, `Becoming.Learning.merged_unrested`, `Becoming.adaptive_state_law_iff`)
11. The formal routes of formation: learning by refutation forms a model from the record; the acquisition chain forms an interpretation of every expression from three encounters; Hebbian development and the route of updating are laws on the joint configuration; the responsive route learns where the task fails.<br>形成的形式路线：按否证学习从记录形成模型，习得链从三次接触形成对全部表达式的解释，Hebb 式发展与更新路线是联合配置上的律，回应路线在失败处学习。 (`Becoming.LearningCorrespondence.uniform_determines`, `Becoming.LearningCorrespondence.hebbian_activity_law_iff`, `Becoming.LearningCorrespondence.updating_network_law_iff`, `Becoming.LearningCorrespondence.responsive_learns`)

## Conditions / 条件

- No axiom and no premise is added; each law's conditions stay in its theorems (balance only where used, the rest of the exchange fixed, decided values, a world held by a list and so on), as in the respective records.<br>不加公理，不加前提；各规律的条件保持在其定理中（平衡只在所用之处、其余交换固定、值可判定、世界被列表所持等），见各自的记录。
- Matching the laws to aspects of wisdom (registration, 理, testing, learning, 明, enough, runaway, proxies, judgment, meta level) is the AI's reading, 理 being Ren's and the rest pending Ren; 明 here means only that seeing beyond one's own registration needs another's, not its whole classical sense; “holding of every representation” means every learner is bound by these laws, not that the wise hold an explicit model.<br>把规律对到智慧的各面（识、理、检验、学习、明、够、失控、代理、判断、元）是 AI 的读法，理依 Ren，其余待 Ren；“明”在这里只指看见自身所识之外要他者之识，不取其全部古典含义；“对每个表示成立”指每个学习者都受这些规律约束，不指有智慧者显式持有一个模型。
- “Holding of every representation” retains each theorem’s types and conditions. Application to wisdom additionally requires judgment content, grounds, scope, strength and E; it does not mean every wise activity has every module’s function or must keep revising.<br>“对每个表示成立”保持各定理的类型与条件。应用于智慧须另说明判断内容、根据、范围、强度及 E；不表示所有智慧活动都具有每个模块的功能或必须继续修改。

## Does not show / 未表明

- The formal laws and routes of formation do not by themselves prove exhaustive wisdom coverage, universal necessity of every core commitment or sufficiency of the relations; full coverage requires argument.<br>形式规律与形成路线本身不证明全部智慧的覆盖、整个 core 每项承诺的普遍必要或关系组的充分性；整体覆盖须论证。
- Actual formation, concern and affect, and historical correspondence have separate evidential burdens.<br>实际形成、关切情感与历史对应另有证据责任。
- A refuting course for each learner is not perpetual revision in every actual world: bounded identification excludes a universal perpetual-revision reading.<br>每个学习者有一个反驳历程，不是每个实际世界要求永久修订：有界识别排除永久修订的普遍读法。 Witness: `Becoming.Identification.held_learner_rests`.
- The pooled-registration examples cited for 明 do not require every improvement to add external information; reorganizing accessible experience is a possible route still needing explanation.<br>“明”所引共同识别例不要求每次改善都新增外部信息，已有经验重组是尚需解释的可能路线。
- The ethical warrant of judgment belongs to Part II.<br>判断的伦理正当性走第二部分。
- **Counterexample / 反例:** Being jointly constrained does not explain wisdom; this record says what wisdom cannot lack and how it fails without it, not when a formation is wise, so it does not upgrade the necessary formal part into a sufficient definition.<br>共同受约束不等于已说明智慧；本记录说出智慧不能缺少什么、缺少时怎样失败，不说出一个形成何时有智慧，所以不把必要的形式部分升级为充分的定义。 [source](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/CORE-CONSTRAINT-AND-WISDOM.md)

Checked: the theorems' statements and their matching to the target's four connections, with author counterreview in the integration note. ### Correspondence / 对应

Ren’s reading of 理 and the formal integration of the laws are retained. Correspondence to aspects of wisdom is an interpretive dependency, not a new Lean composition: which law constitutes which aspect of wisdom is an argument, not a theorem; 理 is read as Ren reads it, and the other readings are the AI's, pending Ren.<br>Ren 的理读法与各规律的形式整合保留。智慧各面的对应是解释性依赖，不是新增 Lean 组合：哪条规律构成智慧的哪一面是论证，不是定理；理依 Ren，其余读法是 AI 的，待 Ren。
